about: Every number and claim this lesson shows or says, with its source. Palm Coast, Florida: a couple wired a contractor $40,000 in December 2025 under an agreement to finish their renovation within three months; the Flagler County Sheriff's Office says he came once, removed and painted one wall and never returned, ignored calls, texts and a certified letter, moved the money out by cash, debit and Zelle within days with none spent on materials, and ran recurring charges on an online auction site for signed baseball cards. He was arrested June 26, 2026, charged with grand theft of more than $20,000 and released on a $50,000 bond. Everything about his conduct is the sheriff's account; no plea or court finding is reported, and no response from him. Every page was opened and read on Nov 26, 2026 in Todd's live chat (WebSearch, then WebFetch on the result's address). We name no person and no business. Not used: the eviction, the 2019 arrest, the auction site's name, the card expert, the sheriff's movie line.

story.title: St. Augustine contractor accused of stealing $40K from couple, spent much on baseball cards
